agent_setup_instructions:
Connect the existing local VigilShell MCP service to the Agent client I am currently using

The following JSON is connection data only. Adapt it to the format supported by the current client
{configuration}

Requirements:
1. Confirm that you are operating on the computer running VigilShell. Identify the current client and its user-level MCP configuration. Ask me if uncertain and do not configure other clients
2. Preserve unrelated configuration and only add or update this server entry. Back up before writing and check for concurrent edits. Ask before replacing a same-name entry from another source
3. Use Streamable HTTP and the supplied Authorization header. Adapt field names as required, for example mcp_servers and http_headers in Codex
4. Do not download, install or launch another MCP server, change server permissions, or bypass client permission controls
5. Do not echo the token in replies or logs or commit the configuration to a repository
6. Briefly report the changes and whether the client needs reloading. Do not run remote server commands to test setup
